tokyo-nikko-irohazaka-and-lake-chuzenji.title: Tokyo · Nikko Irohazaka and Lake Chuzenji
tokyo-nikko-irohazaka-and-lake-chuzenji.slogan: A 303 km loop out of Utsunomiya
tokyo-nikko-irohazaka-and-lake-chuzenji.story: Hairpins, altitude and shrine-country atmosphere for a serious day. 303 km round from Utsunomiya - plan on about 5 h 50 of riding. It goes by way of Nikko shrine stop and Lake Chuzenji water view. Irohazaka hairpins is the high point. It tops out at about 1,350 m. The passes are the reason to go.

scenicChapters.title: Irohazaka · Nikkō
scenicChapters.narrative: For 28 km this is Irohazaka · Nikkō, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Irohazaka · Nikkō
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 9 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

tokyo-nikko-irohazaka-and-lake-chuzenji.storyWas: Hairpins, altitude and shrine-country atmosphere for a serious day.
